plan_rules: Generate one .ts file per type named after the type in PascalCase, placing all files in a single flat directory and using relative imports between them.
style_rules: TypeScript rules: - Target ES2020 with strict mode. - Classes map to classes, abstract classes to abstract classes, interfaces to interfaces, enums to enums (numeric or string). - Visibility uses public/private/protected modifiers; private fields may use # only if noted, otherwise TS private. - Attributes become typed class fields; provide getters/setters only when visibility is restricted. - Inheritance uses extends, interface realization uses implements. - Relations: single-valued (max 1) as typed properties, collections (max > 1) as arrays (T[]), optional (min 0) as optional properties or nullable union. - Import related types using relative import paths with `import { X } from './X'`. - Use ONLY the standard library and built-in types so the code compiles without external packages.
